Why Compensation Matters?


Employee Turnover Costs Based on National Benchmarks

• 50% to 200% of annual salary per employee is the widely accepted range

• A common HR rule of thumb: 6–9 months of salary (≈50%–75%) for many roles

• Average total cost across employers: about $45,000 per employee in recent
  surveys


  Not paying competitive wages often increases long-term costs through
      higher turnover, recruitment expenses, and lost productivity.
